timeline.summary: Promoter Rajesh Agrawal declared no encumbrance on 11,964,987 equity shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Mahamaya Steel reported April 2026 sales of 21,467.960 MT in its monthly business update.
Rajesh Agrawal, as Promoter, declared no encumbrance on 11,964,987 equity shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹263.12 Cr (+11.4% YoY), net profit ₹4.07 Cr (-24.8% YoY).
